PR 10 — the parent portal on the component kit: 15 differences to decide

Build 2026-10-11e, branch claude/consistency-10. Before = the reference pictures on main; after = this branch (CI picture test, Wed 2026-10-07 12:00 Edmonton). Only parent-portal screens changed (96 pictures: iPad 1194×834 and phone 390×844, Pop and Calm); no kid, Week, Day, money or meeting-step screen did. The header (destinations, girl switch, 🔒 Parent ▾) is unchanged by design: it keeps PR 5's exact sizes. ✓ She bought it is unchanged: it stays the Grown-ups' green answer button, as on the cards beside it.

The questions — one per deliberate difference

  1. Approve: green → the main-button colour
  2. Reject and 🗑: white → danger red
  3. Meeting's day tiles: no hover lift, no offset shadow
  4. Meeting's Run family meeting: full width → as wide as its words
  5. History › Analysis: the week rows are kit buttons
  6. History › Analysis: ▶ next week no longer looks greyed
  7. ◀ The way back above every panel: pill → kit button
  8. Now's day squares are kit chips (round)
  9. Her training rating and the learning − / + are kit controls
  10. The panels' own buttons are kit buttons
  11. Now's girl switch and Group them
  12. Now's buttons: kit size and text, no offset shadow

  15. ✏️ Edit on the routine cards: a kit button

1. Approve: green → the main-button colour

Approvals' ✅ Approve was a green button with the old offset shadow; it is now the kit's main button (.ui-btn primary: the look's main fill, kit radius, 1rem text, no offset shadow). Keep the main colour, or should Approve stay green?

2. Reject and 🗑: white → danger red

🗑 Reject (and every 🗑 remove on Approvals and the activity list) was a white button; it is now the kit's danger button (red wash, red text, red frame). Keep the red?

3. Meeting's day tiles: no hover lift, no offset shadow

The Meeting hub's seven day tiles (MON 5 … SUN 11) are kit buttons now. Hovering one no longer lifts it (the old tile moved up-left 1px and grew its shadow; a picture cannot show it), and the tiles lost their offset shadow. Today's outline and the confirmed green are kept. Is losing the lift and the shadow fine?

4. Meeting's Run family meeting: full width → as wide as its words

On the Meeting hub, 🧑‍🧑‍🧒 Run family meeting was a full-width, display-font button with a shadow; as a kit main button it is now only as wide as its words, in the text font. The plan did not ask for this. Should it be full width again?

On One week in detail, ▶ is disabled while you are on this week. The old arrow was greyed out; the kit button has no disabled look, so ▶ now looks tappable though it does nothing. The plan did not ask for this. Should the kit get a disabled look (a later stage), or the portal its own now?

8. Now's day squares are kit chips (round)

On a phone the gap between the seven is 2px, not 4px, so each stays 44px wide. Keep the round chips, or should the day squares keep square corners?
